Both lifts at John Street Square light rail stop (platform towards Dulwich Hill and Central Grand Concourse on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line are temporarily out of service until further notice.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.

Alternative access:
- Use the stairs,
- Or use alternative light rail stops, due to no alternative lift available at this stop.

At John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
